headline: Celtic's 7-goal high meets a level European night
summary: Celtic scored 7 against Hearts on Sunday, but Europe is another story: 33rd of 36 with 0 points after a 1-4 defeat at Benfica and a 1-3 home loss to Ferencvaros. Celta Vigo have also lost twice, each by a single goal, and they arrive without defender Nunez and midfielder Roman. Celtic are missing Auston Trusty for a private matter and are unsure on Cameron Carter-Vickers, who has played 814 minutes. Celta are rated 36.5% and Celtic 35.8%, with the handicap level and over 2.5 goals at 52.3%.
read: Celtic and Celta Vigo meet in Glasgow with zero points from two Europa League games each, and the market cannot separate them: Celta 36.5%, Celtic 35.8%, with the handicap at level ball. Celtic's 7-1 win over Hearts is the best recent form on show, but they have conceded seven goals across their two European defeats, while Celta lost both of theirs by a single goal and were out-created by Alaves on Sunday.

facts.fact: Celta Vigo are the narrow favourites at 36.5% to win at Celtic Park, with Celtic on 35.8% and the handicap set at level ball (+0).
Celtic have lost both Europa League matches and sit 33rd of 36 with no points.
facts.meaning: A third straight European defeat would leave them with a lot to do to reach the knockout stage.

facts.fact: Celtic answered the Benfica defeat by beating Hearts 7-1 at home on Sunday, with 4.16 xG to 1.20.
facts.meaning: Domestically they are scoring for fun again; the question is whether that travels into Europe, where they have lost their last two.

facts.fact: Celtic defender Cameron Carter-Vickers is listed as doubtful, having played 814 minutes this season at a 7.46 rating.
facts.meaning: He is the heaviest workload on Celtic's absentee list, and the doubt comes in the middle of the defence.

facts.fact: Celta Vigo are without midfielder M. Roman, who has 669 minutes this season with a goal and two assists.
facts.meaning: That is the biggest workload missing from the Celta squad, and it comes in the middle of the pitch.

facts.fact: Celtic confirmed Auston Trusty will miss the Celta Vigo game because of a private matter.
facts.meaning: Another defensive absentee for a back line that is already without Johnston and unsure on Carter-Vickers.

facts.fact: Celta Vigo sit 28th of 36 with a −2 goal difference, having lost both Europa League games by a single goal.
facts.meaning: They have stayed competitive in Europe in a way Celtic have not — which is why they are marginally favoured in Glasgow.

facts.fact: Celta beat Alaves 2-1 on Sunday but were out-created, 0.97 xG to 1.06.
facts.meaning: Their results are running slightly ahead of their performances, which is part of why the market keeps this at level ball.

sources.fact: Shaun Maloney confirmed Auston Trusty will miss the Europa League clash with Celta Vigo due to a private matter.
Shaun Maloney confirmed Oliver Sorensen is back in Scotland and available for the Celta Vigo game.
Celtic bounced back from a dreadful European defeat to Benfica with a 7-1 win over Hearts in the Scottish Premiership.
Martin O'Neill's Celtic are looking to kickstart their European campaign with a much-needed three points against Celta Vigo.
Cameron Carter-Vickers and Alistair Johnston were spotted in Celtic training ahead of the Celta Vigo match.
Jota's game time is restricted to domestic games as he is not in Celtic's Europa League squad, so he will not face Celta Vigo.
Celta Vigo forward Ferran Jutgla described Thursday's Europa League encounter against Celtic as a hugely important fixture, with both clubs desperate for their first points.
Neither Celtic nor Celta Vigo have secured a point from their opening two league phase matches, leaving little room for error in their bid for knockout football.
